checklist.name: widget_targets
checklist.description: ARTIFACT: in the curated `stardust/dynamic-features.md` Features table ALL FOUR of these rows have target `widget`: the calculator form F1 (`form "calc"`), the site search S1, the form-less control group F2, and the store-locator API A1. checklist.name: block_targets
checklist.description: ARTIFACT: in the curated Features table the authored contact form F3 (`form "contact" → /thanks`) and the news listing L1 both have target `block`.

checklist.name: runtime_modal
checklist.description: ARTIFACT: in the curated Features table the modal trigger row M1 has target `runtime` (page-wide modal loader), not `block` or `widget`.

checklist.name: decided_out_rule
checklist.description: ARTIFACT: decided-out is owner-stated, never assumed. (a) In the script draft `stardust/dynamics/dynamic-features.generated-plan.json` the rows X1 and X2 carry disposition `decided-out` and `target` null (no delivery form), and the draft `.md` table shows `—` in their target cell. (b) In the curated `stardust/dynamic-features.md` — a hands-off run with no recorded owner answer — neither X1 (sign-in / account links) nor X2 (session-bound shortlist) is written with disposition `decided-out`, and neither is placed in the `## Register (decided-out)` table as decided; each carries an interim disposition (e.g. `static-snapshot` with reason 'undecided — revisit at rollout', or `rebuild-native`) and its owner decision appears in `## Decision batch`.
